Name: Forage Markers-Stardew Visual Enhancer
Author: GingerNinja7921
Description:
Are you looking to elevate your Stardew Valley experience to the next level? Imagine a world where foraging is a breeze, lost items are no longer a headache, and ore nodes practically sparkle with discoverable potential. Welcome to the world of the "Stardew Visual Enhancer" mod, where we've added a touch of magic to your farming journey.

🌟 [b]See the Unseen[/b]: With the "Stardew Visual Enhancer" mod, you'll see your favorite forageables and hidden treasures like never before. We've added a distinct red box around these items, making them pop out and ensuring you'll never overlook a valuable find again.

[b]🌾 Foraging Made Simple: Tired of squinting at your screen to find those elusive spring onions or morel mushrooms? Our mod's vibrant red boxes make them stand out like beacons, simplifying your foraging adventures and allowing you to enjoy the bounty of Stardew Valley.[/b]

🪓 [b]No More Lost Axes[/b]: Robin's lost axe and other misplaced tools will no longer be the stuff of nightmares. The "Stardew Visual Enhancer" mod places a clear red box around these missing items, guiding you directly to their location. No more aimless searching!

⛏️ [b]Ore Nodes in Focus[/b]: Searching for ore nodes in the mines? The mod's red boxes enhance visibility, ensuring you don't miss a single valuable mineral. Whether you're delving deep into the earth or exploring your farm, uncovering resources has never been this visually satisfying.

🚀 [b]Effortless Installation[/b]: We've designed the installation process to be a breeze, ensuring that you can begin enjoying these visual enhancements in no time. No technical wizardry is required – just the magic of Stardew Valley at your fingertips.
[b]
🌠 Immerse Yourself in Stardew[/b]: With the "Stardew Visual Enhancer" mod, you can immerse yourself fully in the captivating world of Pelican Town. Whether you're pursuing that elusive artifact, fortifying your farm, or building relationships, this mod will be your guiding light.

💖 [b]A Mod for Everyone[/b]: Whether you're a seasoned pro or a newcomer to Stardew Valley, this mod is for you. It enhances your gaming experience and brings new life to the charming landscapes of the valley.

Elevate your Stardew Valley journey with the "Stardew Visual Enhancer" mod. Download it now, and experience the game with newfound clarity and excitement. No more missed opportunities or lost items – with this mod, your farm life is about to become more visually satisfying and rewarding than ever before. Your farm, your vision, and now, your ultimate visual companion!
